game: HOU @ JAX Week 6 2026, JAX -2.5, total 42, kickoff weather/venue detail not saved

script.base: One-score game with Jacksonville a small home favorite (implied 22.2-19.8). Tuten keeps the lead-back load (54 carries, 218 yards in weeks 3-5) and Strange stays the target hog (21 targets). Houston, without Montgomery and facing a 3.04 YPC run defense, throws: Stroud has been far better vs the blitz (0.47 EPA/db) than vs a shell (0.02), and Jacksonville blitzes 29%. Pace is normal for a 42 total, not a shootout and not a clock-kill.
script.flip1: Jacksonville is up 14 by halftime off Tuten explosives (Houston has allowed 9 runs of 10+). Houston drops the run, Marks's carries die, Stroud's attempts spike, and Strange's second-half routes get cut as Jacksonville runs the clock.
script.flip2: Houston jumps ahead because Stroud cooks the blitz. Jacksonville abandons the Tuten carry script and throws (Strange/Meyers/Washington up). If Houston then sits on the lead, Hutchinson's target rate dips, but a 14.5 yard rung still has room.

pre_mortem: Monday's miss: Hutchinson's 14.5 was a trap line because he was inactive or capped, or Jacksonville bracketed the 223-air-yard receiver and the 37-yard floor was three games against softer shells than a Brown-replacement plan. Strange lost the way the 32-yard week already sketched, Houston keeping To'oTo'o on the field and spending its 22.2 implied points on Tuten rather than the tight end, or a 14-point Jacksonville lead cutting second-half routes. The correlated miss is a slog (both teams under 20, middle closed), not a blowout, because a blowout still leaves Hutchinson a path to 14.5. That counter-case is real on Strange and is why he is a lean, script-dependent leg; it is not stronger than the 65-vs-37.5 primary-target read, so he stays. It is weaker than the Hutchinson read, which stays and is flagged, not cut.
slip_story: One story: a competitive 22-20 game where both middle-of-field pass games work, not a shootout stack and not a favorite-runs-the-clock stack. Legs that belong: Hutchinson recyds over 14.5 and Strange recyds over 37.5. Do not add a total under, a TD, or Marks rush over (needs Houston to run into a 3.04 YPC defense; dropped). Tuten rush over 62.5 (last-4 65, 73, 73, 72) fits a Jacksonville-leads script but is a different story and was not a top-two overlap edge given only a few yards of cushion. Two legs, one market per player, no depth-receiver add-on.
